title: Evaluating Modern Large Language Models on Low-Resource and Morphologically Rich Languages: A Cross-Lingual Benchmark Across Cantonese, Japanese, and Turkish
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the linguistic performance and cultural appropriateness (in terms of social norms and etiquette, such as honorifics and idioms) of LLMs in three specific languages. It does not evaluate religious, theological, or formal ethical/moral reasoning systems.
